b16.verdict: seam sanity-checked from bytes; disclosures accurate; underlying rival evidence is genuinely non-trivial -- reporting both ways per instructions, no defect in execution
b16.rival_seam: WEB 18:29|18:30 (= MT 18:30|18:31), argued by peer challenge OL-040-1 (high severity) in Ps/freeze/reviews/ol_cluster_c06.json; per CYCLE_STATE.md, BOSS RULING B-16 DECLINED the move because only one primary reviewer (OL) raised it -- 'unlike #12/B-15, the record shows no dual-primary convergence on this shift (single peer RU only); conservative default stands (disclosure treatment adopted)'.
evidence_for_rival_seam: Byte-verified independently from oshb:Ps.18.25-Ps.18.38 (pulled fresh from verse_map_oshb.json, not copied from the peer review): verse-initial tokens of MT 18:26-33 are exactly עִם / עִם / כִּֽי / כִּֽי / כִּֽי / הָאֵל֮ / כִּ֤י / הָ֭אֵל -- a 4-verse anaphoric run on the causal particle כִּי (MT 18:28,29,30,32 = web 18.27,28,29,31), inside which MT 18:31 (= web 18:30, the row's current closing verse) is the SOLE asyndetic (particle-less) opener. Asyndeton after a run of connective openers is a recognized tier-1 strophe-OPENING marker in this campaign's own methodology, which argues MT 18:31/web 18:30 begins the next unit rather than closes the current one.

Independently derived register read of the WEB clean text (Ps.18.24-18.37): WEB 18.25-18.29 sustain direct second-person address to God ('you will show yourself merciful... For you will save... you will light my lamp, Yahweh... by you, I advance'); WEB 18.30 turns to third-person gnomic report ('As for God, his way is perfect... He is a shield...'), and that third-person register continues unbroken through WEB 18.31-18.32 ('who is God, except Yahweh? ...the God who arms me'). On a pure register read, WEB 18.30 groups with the following third-person unit at least as naturally as with the preceding second-person unit.

The designation-and-integrity frame (הָאֵל/תָּמִים דַּרְכּוֹ, oshb 18.31) and the shield epithet (מָגֵן, oshb 18.31/18.36) both straddle whichever seam is chosen -- this is a real structural tension, not manufactured by either side.
evidence_for_current_seam: Row 040's own rationale treats web 18.30 as a self-standing 'summary confession' that closes the personal-application arc opened at web 18.25 ('with the merciful you will show yourself merciful...') and answers the psalm's own opening epithet at web 18.2 ('Yahweh is my rock') -- a coherent thematic unit distinct from OL's syntactic argument.

Both rows 040 and 041 already fully and accurately disclose the exact frame-split (הָאֵל/תָּמִים דַּרְכּוֹ) and epithet-echo (מָגֵן) that OL's challenge relies on, explicitly framed as cross-seam continuity rather than hidden -- verified present in both rows' rationale/observed_substrate_signals/device_notes fields.

No corroborating LF (second-primary) challenge for this seam was found anywhere in Ps/freeze/reviews/ (searched all files containing '18:29'); B-16's 'single peer RU only' characterization checks out.
